problem_title: K-th Highest Rating in a Stream
input_contract: An object with 'nums' (list of integers) and 'k' (positive integer).

variants.name: Min-Heap (Streaming)
variants.strategy: Maintain a min-heap of size k, push each rating, pop smallest if size exceeds k, heap top is k-th largest.

pseudocode: For each rating: push; if size > k, pop smallest

events.reason: After all numbers, the 2-th highest is 5

variants.name: Sort and Select
variants.strategy: Sort the array in descending order and return the element at index k-1.
variants.space_complexity: O(n) (or O(1) depending on sorting algorithm)
variants.code:
def solve(input_data):
    nums = input_data['nums']
    k = input_data['k']
    sorted_nums = sorted(nums, reverse=True)
    return sorted_nums[k-1]
